name: ClothoAQA
intro: ClothoAQA 是基于 1,991 段 Clotho 环境音频构建的音频问答基准，通过两阶段众包获得 35,838 个音频-问题-答案三元组，评估模型联合理解音频与自然语言问题的能力。
build_method: 两阶段Amazon Mechanical Turk众包提问与独立回答，经人工筛查、罕见答案修正和音频无重叠分层划分
eval_feature: 音频问答, 二分类与828类单词分类, 一致票与多数票变体, 音频无重叠划分
scale: 1,991段音频、11,946个问题、35,838个音频问答三元组
build_method_en: Two-stage Amazon Mechanical Turk question and independent answer annotation, followed by manual screening, rare-answer correction, and audio-disjoint stratified splitting
eval_feature_en: Audio QA, binary and 828-class single-word classification, unanimous and majority-vote variants, audio-disjoint splits
intro_en: ClothoAQA is an audio question-answering benchmark built from 1,991 Clotho environmental audio clips. Two-stage crowdsourcing produces 35,838 audio-question-answer triplets for evaluating joint audio and natural-language understanding.
scale_en: 1,991 audio clips, 11,946 questions, and 35,838 audio-QA triplets
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2204.09634 and the official Zenodo release. ClothoAQA starts from 1,991 randomly selected 15-30 second Clotho environmental-audio clips. Qualified English-speaking Amazon Mechanical Turk workers create two distinct sets of three questions per clip, with one yes, one no, and one other single-word-answer question in each set. Questions are manually screened for type errors, speech-content dependence, answer leakage, and direct address. A separate worker pool supplies three answers plus yes/no/maybe confidence for every question. In-house post-processing corrects typos or semantically replaces single-occurrence single-word answers, reducing unique answers from 1,889 to 830. Audio-disjoint multi-label stratification produces 1,174 train, 344 validation, and 473 test clips, for 11,946 questions and 35,838 audio-question-answer triplets. Baselines treat yes/no as binary classification and other answers as 828-class single-word classification, compare unfiltered, unanimous, and majority-vote variants, and report Accuracy plus top-1 and top-5 accuracy, including audio-question, question-only, and audio-only ablations.
